note: One example is one training 'long video': 10 consecutive rows of the similarity-ordered qa_groups.json (the README's GROUP_LEN=10 grouping), each row one short clip with a GPT-4o caption, one QA, 5 options and a type (OP object, AR action, SA spatial/attribute, CR causal, EU event, UEH unexpected event, OCR, SR sequence). The file has no timestamps; for example 1 we downloaded all 10 clips, concatenated them in group order and took t/te from the measured clip durations, so those times are our reconstruction, not dataset fields.
